turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
Nothing, until you've answered me. Who decided?
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
I'm not writing anything for you to read to my son. Was he heard before the zero went in, yes or no?
